transport: node .planning/audit/tools/sql-readonly.mjs — Supabase Management API POST /v1/projects/<PROD-PROJECT-REF>/database/query with read_only: true, enforced SERVER-SIDE and outside the client's reach (AR-12 clause 2 by construction)
mcp_scoping: The Supabase MCP endpoint in this checkout is scoped to https://mcp.supabase.com/mcp?project_ref=<PROD-PROJECT-REF>&read_only=true — read_only=true applies to execute_sql AND apply_migration; project_ref disables account-level management tools. `.mcp.json` is untracked and is not committed. This plan issued no MCP call; the scoping is recorded as the standing control.
credential_handling: The Management API token is the Supabase CLI's own stored token (macOS keychain, service "Supabase CLI"), read into process.env in the same process that needed it and never written anywhere. The production project ref is read from the gitignored `supabase/.temp/project-ref` and substituted with <PROD-PROJECT-REF> before any byte reaches disk or stdout. `.env.local` was not opened by any step of this plan, and no database password was read — this plan issues no libpq connection. No command in this plan enabled shell tracing.
